Accounts Receivable is your chase list.
The top row groups everything by where it has got to — Outstanding, Requested, Received.
Below that is the aging: everything unpaid, sorted by how long it has been sitting.
Zero to thirty, thirty-one to sixty, sixty-one to ninety, ninety-one to one-twenty, and over one-twenty.
Twenty-one thousand of that is more than four months old, which is a phone call, not an email.
You can request a payment straight from a row, open the documents behind it, or jump to the project.
Mark it received here and every other screen catches up.
